title: On the Precipice program carousel

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Move from headline to details because a short social sequence must attract attention before asking for sustained reading.
strategic_value: The red and burgundy palette can connect an expressive program announcement with informative follow-up cards.
demonstration: A social carousel begins with animated On the Precipice typography and June 17–26 2021 dates, then slides to descriptive and program cards.
practical_value: Sequence expressive introduction, explanation and individual event information within one campaign.

content_islands.name: Opening card
content_islands.spec: Retain the changing-height headline and dates on the bright red field.

content_islands.name: Information cards
content_islands.spec: Follow with burgundy and red panels containing smaller descriptive text and program headings.
